svg.aria-label: Stokes theorem: tiny loops tiling a surface cancel along every shared edge so only the rim survives; one tiny loop gives the curl components; a paddle wheel spins in a curling field and not in a uniform one
svg.text: Curl is circulation per unit area; add up the tiny loops and only the rim is left

text.tspan: Circulation, curl and Stokes — from the loop law to the point law
